title: Enhanced electrochemical performance of a polyaniline-based supercapacitor by a bicontinuous microemulsion nanoreactor approach
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,1205-1211
DOI: 10.1039/D4RA07348G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Yelriza Yeszhan, Sagydat Duisenbekov, Dana Kurmangaliyeva, Dana Kazhigitova, Perizat Askar, Yerbol Tileuberdi, Aishuak Konarov, Salimgerey Adilov, Nurxat Nuraje
A novel bicontinuous microemulsion nanoreactor was developed to produce unique PANI nanofibers and a 3D crosslinked PANI architecture to enhance the mechanical stability and electrochemical performance for further application in supercapacitors.
